dedupeText: rustic americana album cover western typography sepia tone woodland background distressed texture victorian flourishes musicians with instruments text heavy upper third balanced by photographic lower two thirds ornate victorian flourishes framing the primary and secondary titles high contrast white lettering against dark burgundy and textured backgrounds desaturated cool toned forest photography contrasting with warm burgundy header combine a color header block with spurred slab serif type an arched subtitle framed by victorian filigree and a desaturated textured photograph for a classic americana aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered composition featuring a dark burgundy header with ornate western-style lettering, a central band of distressed subtitle text framed by filigree, and a desaturated, sepia-toned photograph of three musicians in a forest setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy upper third balanced by photographic lower two-thirds
Ornate Victorian flourishes framing the primary and secondary titles
High-contrast white lettering against dark burgundy and textured backgrounds
Desaturated, cool-toned forest photography contrasting with warm burgundy header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three musicians seated in the lower foreground, waist-up, occupying the bottom 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, spurred slab-serif title in the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting at the bold title, moving through the arched subtitle and filigree, resting on the musicians' faces and instruments.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with texture, type, and foliage.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted forest greens and sepia browns (photograph)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in text; low saturation in the photographic elements to create a vintage feel.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged first and last letters for framing
Custom flourishes extending from the terminals of the main title

treatment.fill: Solid white with inner grit texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, spurred display face paired with a lighter, arched decorative serif for a 'Wild West' playbill aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines with central peaks

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the spurred, western slab-serif aesthetic of the main title.
Matches the ornate, arched subtitle and filigree style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A desaturated, sepia-toned photograph of three musicians (two men with guitars/banjos, one woman in center) in a dense, slightly out-of-focus forest. Add a solid dark burgundy bar across the top 20% of the frame. Apply a heavy 'old paper' or 'dust and scratches' texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, white, spurred western slab-serif title centered in the burgundy bar. Below it, add a secondary title in a cream-colored decorative serif, following an upward arch. Frame the secondary title with symmetrical Victorian-style line flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the top bar a deep burgundy?
Does the main title have mid-stem spurs?
Is the photography desaturated and textured?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the spurs on the letters are consistent.
Ensure the texture doesn't obscure the legibility of the text.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the photographic section.
Confirm the filigree is horizontally symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] header block with [Spurred Slab Serif] type, an [Arched] subtitle framed by [Victorian Filigree], and a [Desaturated/Textured] photograph for a classic Americana aesthetic.
